definition: G from generalized Maxwell-model fitting; conditional on observed gel formation; reference DOI 10.1016/j.ijbiomac.2020.05.088.
units: Polymer percentages and fractions as recorded; derived nominal pre-crosslinking component concentration = stock * fraction. Ion dose_M = 10 * recorded mol/100 ml; not internal/free-ion concentration.
scope: Neutral pH, original preparation and fitting protocol. LAP/GO excluded. No trained gel classifier: only four negative observations.

hill.validation: Leave one full ALG concentration out (4 folds); pure ALG + Ca only; no gel threshold inferred.
